criteria_location: POSITION STATEMENT, pp.1-2: one all-of list for TMR in no-option angina, one adjunct-to-CABG paragraph, two investigational statements (all other indications; percutaneous TMR).

logic.top_level: pathways: (1) standalone TMR all-of five criteria, (2) adjunct to CABG single criterion; then not covered otherwise
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Inline negatives in the all-of list: 'No evidence of recent myocardial infarction (MI) or unstable angina within the last 21 days' and 'No severe comorbid illness such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: members with class III or IV angina, who are not candidates for coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery or percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty (PTCA) surgery who meet ALL of the following criteria
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'not candidates for CABG or PTCA' could mean not a candidate for either or for both; it is a precondition sentence before the ALL list, and may be mis-read as an extra bullet.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: No evidence of recent myocardial infarction (MI) or unstable angina within the last 21 days; AND
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'within the last 21 days' modifies both MI and unstable angina, presumably.

requirement_kinds.quote: Presence of class III or IV angina refractory to medical management;
Left ventricular ejection fraction greater than 30%;
No evidence of recent myocardial infarction (MI) or unstable angina within the last 21 days
No severe comorbid illness such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
who are not candidates for coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery or percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty (PTCA) surgery
documented areas of ischemic myocardium that are amenable to surgical revascularization

thresholds.quote: Left ventricular ejection fraction greater than 30%

time_windows.what: no recent MI or unstable angina

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: No: CPT 33140, 33141 and ICD-10 I20.0-I20.9, I25.110-I25.119, I25.89, I25.9 (angina / chronic ischemic heart disease) are a flat screen; the criteria add severity (class III/IV) which no code expresses.
codes.non_covered_code_lists: none (percutaneous TMR has no code listed)

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: Canadian Cardiovascular Society (CCS) functional classification for angina: Marked limitation of ordinary activity. Angina when walking one or two blocks on the level, or when climbing one flight of stairs at a normal pace.
Inability to carry on any physical activity without discomfort. Angina may be present at rest.
a clinical cardiac measurement – end-systolic volume-end-systolic volume end diastolic volume = ejection fraction.

vague_terms.quote: No severe comorbid illness such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
vague_terms.problem: 'severe' and 'such as' leave the comorbidity set open.

vague_terms.quote: not candidates for coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery
vague_terms.problem: who decides candidacy is not stated.

extraction_hazards: Guideline number on the first line is clipped ('02-33000-1'); file name uses a random token.
Definition of ejection fraction contains a garbled formula ('end-systolic volume-end-systolic volume end diastolic volume').
Bullets are five U+F0B7 glyphs; sentence-final semicolons and 'AND' on the penultimate bullet.
Precondition ('who are not candidates ... who meet ALL') is in the lead sentence, not a bullet.
interesting_structures: Clinical grading scale (CCS class) defined in DEFINITIONS and used as a threshold in the Position Statement.
Short all-of with numeric LVEF and a 21-day look-back.

fit_to_tree.why: textbook all-of with a precondition and two negative leaves; definitions supply CCS grade meanings. Only 'severe comorbid illness' and 'refractory' need judgment.
